d:
Retro story set in the mid 1960s

A romance dramatization between a Mother & her Son

Living alone in a Lighthouse on a remote Italian Island, after their Husband/Father had been killed in a fishing boat accident.

Both the family members living a lonely solitary life.

The beautiful Mother 'Gina', tries to raise her son the best that she can.

Through the years the son ( age progression to 18 years old), begins to have unnatural taboo feelings towards her..

Please save to favorites for future visits...
